name: Calibre
tagline: Converts your ebooks between formats without leaving the chat
description: Send it a book, say which format you need it in, and the rebuilt file comes back to you in the conversation. It stands up the open-source Calibre toolchain itself, so there is no desktop application to install, no settings panel to learn, and nothing has to be uploaded to some third-party conversion site along the way.
author: doitian
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
